Name: Jehozabad, Son of Shimrith
Summary: Jehozabad, son of Shimrith a Moabitess, was one of the servants who conspired against Joash and slew him on his bed.
KeyStory: Jehozabad the son of Shimrith joined Zabad in conspiring against Joash for the blood of Jehoiada's sons.
RelatedPeople: Joash, King of Judah; Shimrith, the Moabitess
LifeLesson: Those who avenge innocent blood can themselves become murderers.
